auth_param.description: Header name (for bearer/header) or query param name (for query_param)

auth_env_var.description: Environment variable name holding the secret (not the value)

default_headers.description: Headers always sent with requests using this context

description.description: Human-readable description of what this context is for

kind.description: Its data kind, one of the closed list in the graph ((:ApiKind): news-feed, reference-catalog, forecast, dataset, job-postings, device-state, code-hosting, search, advisories). Omit it and pass no topics to let the tagger (nimble) propose tags for an untagged API; "" clears.

topics.description: The (:Topic) names it serves (0..n); [] for none (weather, a model catalog). A `search` API serves none. Replaces the stored set.

endpoints.description: For an API with no OpenAPI spec: the endpoints you found, saved so list_endpoints shows them. Each GET endpoint is CALLED once before it is saved, and the result says which answered (status, response shape, and `sample`: a few real values from the response, the only values you may quote): that is the proof it works. A path with a {placeholder} needs `example`, a concrete path to call.

example.description: A concrete path to probe when `path` has a {placeholder}, e.g. 'by-kind/CHAT.json'
